name: Formula 2000 Special
description: A water-based detergent formulated to remove grease, grime, and oil from floors, engines, and machinery. Can be used in floor-cleaning machines.
application: Light-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:20 to 1:35 with water. Medium-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:10 to 1:12 with water. Heavy-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:4 to 1:6 with water. 1) Dilute product with water according to chart above. 2) Apply solution to surface with a mop, brush or sponge. 3) If needed, scrub or agitate the surface. 4) Permit the solution to remain on the surface for a few minutes. 5) Rinse and clean with water. Test product on an inconspicuous area for compatibility before using it on the entire surface. Avoid prolonged contact with aluminum, magnesium, and painted surfaces. Can cause spotting or damage, always use in diluted form.
